scope: Shared resource sliders with numeric entry and inline provider identities
controls: Pinned iced-m3 native sliders and text fields; whole GiB and physical-core steps; ticks only on small ranges.
bounds: Create uses uncommitted quota and configured per-VM disk overhead
Edit reuses current backing, preserves above-quota allocations and prevents disk shrinking
Stopped CPU/RAM configuration is checked on the later Start
Grant limits retain other users promised or committed backing including disabled users
Form ranges remain fixed through refresh; server admission remains authoritative
New forms choose defaults inside their ranges; grants may be zero
provider_rows: Owner-only Codex/Claude email and plan sit beside the provider name where they fit; long metadata wraps.
backend_change: Read-only Snapshot.disk_overhead_gib_per_vm comes from Limits; older snapshots retain a 2 GiB default.
native_interaction_proofs: disk slider cannot shrink; typed shrink disables Save
restart confirmation remains staged and targeted
provider metadata shares the name row and long email wraps without clipping
